ImageDescription.value:
License plate modalities in the Mercosul standard, as implemented in Brazil from 2018, last plate introduced in 2022. The colors of the characters and the border indicate the vehicle category.
  • Black characters on white background, black border: private
  • Red characters on white background, red border: commercial, for any kind of paid/hire transportation - trucks/lorries, public transit buses, coaches, taxis, etc. and driving schools.
  • Blue characters on white background, blue border: official, belonging to federal, state and municipality governments, e.g., police, ambulance, firefighting engines, etc.
  • Gold characters on white background, golden border: diplomatic use
  • Green characters on white background, green border: experience (for tests by automobile factories, automakers, auto repair shops, garages, etc.)
  • Gray characters on white background, gray border: collectors, for vehicles above 30 years showing high degree of originality, for use inside and outside Brazil
  • White characters on black background, white border: collectors, for vehicles above 30 years showing high degree of originality, use only in Brazil (introduced in 2022)
